contexts.text: The like is meant by, Make yourselves friends of the mammon of injustice (). AE 141:13.
By the mammon of injustice are meant the Knowledges of truth and good which are possessed by the evil, and which they use solely to procure for themselves dignity and wealth...
These are the gains of the unjust mammon.
These were called mammons by the Ancients...
This would be to serve... God and mammon; and then the man is lukewarm... AE 409:7.
By the unjust mammon are meant the Knowledges of truth and good with those who do not justly possess them, who are those who do not apply them to life. AE 430:11.
As they are still Knowledges, although applied to evils, they serve for use with the good, by application to good... This is what is meant also by the unjust mammon.
